$comment: Canonical, machine-checkable merge-gate policy for MarkFlow-private.
The required/advisory/staged/release-only arrays are the only policy classification.
The audit compares the required producer definitions with workflow files and, when an
explicit repository-administration credential is supplied, with the live rulesets.
Scheduled/manual workflow execution is credential-less by default; privileged live
readback is explicit opt-in or external exit-audit evidence, never inferred from CI.
A staged control is not claimed to be live or required until the corresponding evidence
and live settings change have both been completed.

required.covers: Kotlin/Gradle compile, webview TypeScript production build, plugin packaging
Gradle check (Kotlin unit tests) and the webview source test suite
Authoritative Qodana static-analysis job, including its fail-closed SARIF threshold
IntelliJ plugin structure verification and Plugin Verifier compatibility targets

staged_required.covers: Policy/producer integrity, workflow security checks, static analysis, and fail-closed fixtures
staged_required.promotion: Only after this context is observed on merged main and ordinary pull requests, promote this exact context in this policy and the live main ruleset together.

advisory.reason: Posted by Qodana itself and not stable across linter editions; Inspect code is the authoritative required job.

release_only.reason: Runs only from an explicit GitHub Release event after tag/source/version/artifact preflight; it is never a pull-request merge check.

$comment: gate checks are offline and run in the staged Hardening audit job on PR/push/schedule/manual events.
report checks require authoritative live GitHub readback and are run only from an explicit admin-controlled audit path.
The optional in-Actions live-readback job is disabled by default and requires an explicit repository-variable opt-in plus scoped credential.
The Hardening audit context itself remains staged_required until live promotion evidence exists.

staged.blocked_by: Hardening audit remains staged until reliable ordinary-PR/merged-main evidence and authoritative external or explicitly enabled admin readback are both available.
staged.when: after authoritative live readback proves policy/live-main agreement and the staged context has reliable PR/main evidence; no long-lived Actions admin credential is required

staged.blocked_by: Release-tag protection is verified by privileged live readback and is not a pull-request merge context.
staged.when: during explicit release-provenance or hardening exit audits

staged.blocked_by: Hardening audit is intentionally staged until ordinary PR and merged-main reliability evidence exists.
staged.when: after the context is observed on merged main and ordinary pull requests, add it to required and the live main ruleset in one reviewed change
